method: One-sided analytic control of the exact activation scalar, endpoint-deficit recurrence, and complete signed restriction-tree telescope with terminal tensor cancellation.
mathematical_delta: Extended the constant-two retained-credit theorem from one dense nullity-two shield to arbitrary-depth towers with genuinely biased mean -1/2 AND balancers; improved the general endpoint threshold from 72/35 to 48/35.

case_extension.starting_class: One dense nullity-two bilinear shield with arbitrary coherent core and common disjoint terminal core.
case_extension.new_class: Arbitrary-depth fresh half-activation towers with a mean -1/2 two-bit AND balancer at every positive level above any U<=cI base.
case_extension.prior_constant: biased-tower endpoint c>=72/35; dense shield retained-credit constant 2 only before tower extension
case_extension.new_constant: endpoint c>=48/35; dense shield tower retains c=2 exactly

remaining_obstacle: The proof fixes fair outer selectors, fresh variables, and balancer mean -1/2. It supplies no bias-uniform credit as the balancer mean approaches plus or minus one and no payment for changing overlapping coherent cores.
next_action: Derive the exact endpoint-deficit recurrence for a one-parameter Boolean balancer family and test whether its selector-energy offset keeps the threshold bounded uniformly in the balancer mean.
